name: Reoon Email Verifier
summary: Email verification in a fast quick mode (syntax, disposable, MX, role) or a deep power mode (inbox exists, full, disabled, catch-all, score), bulk task results and credit balance.

api_key.description: A Reoon Email Verifier API key (created on the API page of the Reoon dashboard). Sent as the key query parameter.

notes: Credits come in two pools, daily and instant; the balance call shows both.
Creating a bulk task takes the key and up to 50,000 emails in a JSON body and is not in this entry; the result call reads a task created elsewhere (dashboard or API).

endpoints.name: Verify one email
endpoints.summary: Status, syntax, disposable, role, free-provider, spamtrap and MX checks; power mode adds inbox existence, full inbox, disabled, catch-all, safe-to-send and an overall score out of 100.

mode.description: quick (default, under 0.5 s) or power (deep check, a few seconds to over a minute; a power check can outlast call_vendor's fixed 60-second timeout, so retry a timed-out one).

notes: Quick mode does not check the mailbox: any address at a domain that accepts mail comes back valid. Its statuses are valid, invalid, disposable, spamtrap.
Power mode statuses: safe, invalid, disabled, disposable, inbox_full, catch_all, role_account, spamtrap, unknown.
Not for bulk work: keep to 5 concurrent calls at most.

endpoints.name: Get a bulk verification task's results
endpoints.summary: Status and progress of a bulk task and, once completed, the power-mode result of each email.

task_id.description: The task_id returned when the bulk task was created.

notes: Task status is waiting, running, completed, file_not_found or file_loading_error; results are present only when completed. Tasks run one after another.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: API status and the daily and instant credits left.
